title: croton antisyphiliticus var. weddellianus
intro: Croton antisyphiliticus var. weddellianus, commonly known as a variety of the Croton species, is a plant used in traditional medicine. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiparasitic properties, making it useful in treating various ailments. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to act as an antiseptic, antiarthritic, and antimalarial agent. The bioactive constituents of Croton antisyphiliticus var. weddellianus include limonoids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
